text: Nintendo Co., Ltd. (TSE code 7974) lists its major shareholders as of 31 March 2026 as The Master Trust Bank of Japan, Ltd. (trust account, 16.05%), Custody Bank of Japan, Ltd. (trust account, 5.02%), JP Morgan Chase Bank 380752 (3.75%), The Bank of Kyoto, Ltd. (3.37%), State Street Bank and Trust Company 505001 (2.67%), Chase Manhattan Bank London (2.50%), Citibank as depositary for depositary shares (2.22%) and GIC Private Limited (2.10%).
short: Nintendo is Tokyo-listed; its largest holders are trust banks; Singapore's GIC holds 2.10%.
